data.body: ADR numbering note (2026-09-07): 0119 in this story, in the sibling runbook story (`scripts/run_live_matrix.py` docstring "archived into ADR 0119 §20"), and in the epic is a PLACEHOLDER. Task arterial-bilineate-vampirebat (a01e-01e7-6e6e-4809) also targets ADR 0117, and the CLI and MCP epics' ADRs (placeholders 0117 and 0118) land before this one, so the real number is the next free one at landing (`ls docs/adr/.numbers | sort | tail -1`, plus one). Substitute it in the new file name, the `.numbers` marker, the twenty archived originals' status lines and banners, `docs/adr/README.md`, and the runbook story's docstring edit. The file slug `reconciler-architecture-consolidated-record` is unchanged, so `scripts/gen_adr_index.py`'s classification is unaffected.
